title: Erasing an interval of tape cells
statement: Given a tape $t:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ and natural numbers $h$ and $len$, define a new tape that is blank at every integer cell $c$ satisfying $h\le c\le len$, and agrees with $t$ at all other cells.
hypotheses_covered: $t$ is an integer-indexed tape with optional Boolean contents
